incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A street in a town is flooded with brown water, submerging the lower floors of multi-story buildings and blocking access to storefronts.

observations.description: Brown, murky water covers the street, reaching up to the bases of buildings and submerging storefronts.
Multi-story buildings with European architectural style line the flooded street. Some have balconies and arched doorways.
No visible vehicles in the floodwater.
No visible people in the image.
No visible vegetation in the immediate scene.

Road signs are visible on the right: a red circular 'stop' sign and a blue arrow pointing left. A yellow sign above a doorway reads 'LAVANDERIE' in Italian, and a sign above a window reads 'PIAZZA DELLA LIBERTÀ' (Piazza della Libertà) in Italian.

inconsistencies: Report mentions 'Nabeul', but the image shows a European-style town with signs in Italian (e.g., 'Piazza della Libertà') — suggesting a location in Italy, not Tunisia.
